scope: Six explicitly selected saved final result JSONs; offline independent recomputation; no model/service/experiment calls

definitions.success: saved reward_info.reward == 1; success_rate denominator all saved simulations; mean_reward denominator valid finite numeric reward
definitions.pairing: unique string(task_id), trial; duplicate keys preserved as anomalies and excluded from unique pair statistics
definitions.exact_McNemar: two-sided doubled binomial tail with min(wins,losses), p capped at1; binary paired reward only; scene correlation caveat
definitions.task_bootstrap: per-task mean paired deltas; random.Random(42), 10000 resamples; preserve B0 first appearance order; indexes250,9749; round4; source-script equivalent
definitions.pass_power_k: average C(c,k)/C(4,k), all-success estimator from four observed binary trials per task
definitions.pass_at_k: average 1-C(4-c,k)/C(4,k), any-success estimator from four observed binary trials per task
definitions.duration: saved duration seconds; percentile interpolation index p*(n-1)
definitions.business_tools: tool_calls in saved tau2 messages, all requestor roles; excludes external skills Read/LLM requests
definitions.native_tool_error: tool reply.error is true; no inferred semantic-error classifier
definitions.unknown_cost: assistant usage and sim costs null do not establish zero token/monetary cost; no all-ledger cost attribution
definitions.subgroups: telecom issue/persona parsed from task_id; post hoc descriptive, no multiplicity-adjusted claims
